emerging.label: CC BY 4.0
emerging.note: Credit the authors and the selected release DOI; indicate changes.

eora.note: Eora1 academic use covers theses, assignments and peer-reviewed papers; websites/software tools require a commercial licence or specific permission. exiobase-monetary.note: The release-specific licence adds definitions to a CC-BY-SA-NC-derived licence. Use the actual LICENSE.txt supplied with each release, including its conditions for derived results.

exiobase-hybrid.label: CC BY 4.0
exiobase-hybrid.note: Credit the Hybrid authors and indicate changes. This is the licence of the supported 3.3.18 deposit; separate consequential releases must be checked independently.

figaro.label: Eurostat data reuse policy
figaro.note: Acknowledge Eurostat and the FIGARO dataset, indicate modifications and respect any release-specific or third-party notices.

gloria.label: CC BY-NC 3.0 Australia
gloria.note: Attribute GLORIA and its providers. Non-commercial reuse is covered; commercial applications use separate terms. The native source GHG methodology and archive vintage remain attached to each reading.

gtap.note: GTAP is supplied under a licence agreement. Access and redistribution depend on your licence; a MARIO parser does not grant rights to distribute GTAP data.

istat.label: CC BY 4.0
istat.note: Credit Istat and indicate changes, unless the selected release specifies different conditions.

oecd.label: OECD Data terms
oecd.note: Data may be copied, adapted and shared, including commercially, with the required OECD attribution, except where dataset-specific or third-party restrictions apply. These data terms are distinct from the licence of OECD written publications.

statcan.label: Statistics Canada Open Licence
statcan.note: Reuse and adaptation are allowed for lawful purposes, with Statistics Canada attribution and without implying endorsement.

useeio.label: EPA ScienceHub data licence
useeio.note: Use the licence shown on the exact USEEIO deposit and acknowledge the EPA dataset. The licence of the USEEIO software does not replace the licence of its source data.

wiod.label: CC BY 4.0
wiod.note: Credit the WIOD release and cite its user-guide paper. Separate third-party environmental extensions can carry their own notices.

custom-database-from-excel.label: Input database licence

custom-database-from-txt.label: Input database licence

custom-database-from-pymrio.label: Input database licence

eora2.label: Eora2 source terms
eora2.note: Public classification metadata only; source rights retained. Numerical database downloads, website use and the Eora2 subscription are separate from historical Eora1 access. No MARIO parser or numerical indicators are supplied here.

ceda.label: CEDA · proprietary source access
ceda.note: CEDA denotes the proprietary product. The displayed set inventory is extracted from Open CEDA, whose CC BY-SA 4.0 terms apply to the metadata extract. These terms do not grant access to the proprietary CEDA product. No MARIO parser or numerical indicators are supplied here.

bonsai.label: BONSAI source terms
bonsai.scope: Native b2 HIOT snapshot supplied for this analysis
bonsai.note: Data-specific reuse terms are not classified here. BONSAI attribution is retained; the software licence does not establish the licence of the input data.
